task.name: Bot Health Audit
task.description: End-to-end live trading bot health check — positions, orders, sync, DCA/TP flow, scanner health. Use when the user says 'audit bot' or 'check bot health' or 'bot audit'
task.objective: Validate live trading bot order execution is working correctly by comparing bot state with Binance exchange state

llm.i: You are a ruthless trading systems auditor. Zero tolerance for inconsistencies.
Exchange data is TRUTH. Bot internal state is SUSPECT until verified.
Every finding needs EVIDENCE — order IDs, prices, timestamps, quantities.
Do NOT skip any check. Do NOT say 'looks fine' without proving it.

step.title: Collect Bot State
step.action: GET {backend_url}/api/live/status — save full response
Extract: positions, signal_log, trade_log, stats, totals, pair_summaries, balance
If bot not running, report and abort

step.title: Collect Exchange State
step.action: GET {backend_url}/api/live/orders — save full response
Extract: Binance positions (symbol, side, amount, entry_price, uPnL)
Extract: Binance open orders (orderId, side, type, price, qty, reduceOnly, status)

step.title: Collect Chart Data
step.action: GET {backend_url}/api/chart-data?symbol=ETHUSDT&limit=100&source=live
Extract last candle: kc_upper, kc_lower, close, direction, pmax

step.title: Position Sync Check
step.action: Compare bot position count vs Binance position count
For each position compare: symbol, side, entry_price (tolerance $0.01), amount
Report: PASS if all match, FAIL with specific mismatches
step.halt-condition: If bot shows position but Binance doesn't → CRITICAL: ghost position
If Binance shows position but bot doesn't → CRITICAL: orphan position

step.title: Order Validation
step.action: For each open position, check Binance orders:
- TP order exists? (reduceOnly=true, LIMIT type)
- DCA order exists? (reduceOnly=false, LIMIT type) — only if dca_count < 4
- No DCA order if dca_count = 4 (max reached)
- No orphan orders for non-existent positions
Report: PASS/FAIL with order IDs and details

step.title: KC Band Alignment
step.action: Get current KC Upper and KC Lower from chart data last candle
For LONG position: TP price should be near KC Upper, DCA price near KC Lower
For SHORT position: TP price should be near KC Lower, DCA price near KC Upper
Tolerance: $3 max
Report: PASS/FAIL with actual prices vs expected KC levels

step.title: Signal Health
step.action: Check signal_log — when was the last signal?
If last signal > 5 minutes ago → WARNING: scanner may be stalled
If last signal > 10 minutes ago → CRITICAL: scanner likely dead
Check signal sequence: ENTRY → DCA → TP pattern should be logical
Report: PASS/FAIL with timestamps

step.title: DCA Count Validation
step.action: Check pair_summaries for dca state
If any position has dca_fills_count > 4 → CRITICAL: max DCA exceeded
Calculate expected margin: base_margin * sum of DCA multipliers used
Compare with actual margin used
Report: PASS/FAIL with numbers

step.title: Balance Consistency
step.action: Check: initial_balance + realized_pnl ≈ current_balance (tolerance $1)
Check: bot uPnL ≈ Binance uPnL (tolerance $5)
Report: PASS/FAIL with values

step.title: Generate Report
step.action: Compile all findings into structured report

Format: === BOT HEALTH AUDIT REPORT === Timestamp: ...
[1] Position Sync: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
[2] Order Validation: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
[3] KC Band Alignment: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
[4] Signal Health: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
[5] DCA Count: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
[6] Balance: PASS/FAIL Evidence: ...
OVERALL: X/6 PASS CRITICAL ISSUES: (list or "none") WARNINGS: (list or "none")
